snippet.title: Spooker Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Now on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4571310/Spooker/
Join us on Discord! https://discord.gg/FT5Hxm6Vjq


A roguelite pool-like game where you play for your freedom against your host and lightly cursed ventriloquist dummy, Ralphie. Steady your shots, build your combos and rack up enough points to make your escape. Good luck!

RACK ‘EM UP. SINK ‘EM DOWN. TRY TO SURVIVE.


Press Kit https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1P1Ie5pVGZ_GAKAc4YZUKhwXwSbZPzw0E?usp=drive_link
